dataset.selection: For each row r=0..15, choose pointFixtures()[10*r + (3*r)%10]; preserve increasing row order
dataset.label: Unique complete pointReference optimal first action, mapped to unchanged legal candidate order; STOP on incomplete or nonunique reference
dataset.materialization: Future approved execution only; new isolated artifact, never appended to previous train/dev/test

input.construction: Unchanged encodeDecision 52 features + actionOutcome 22 features for every legal candidate + encodeFootprints binary geometry; no target, label, key, fixture id or reference score enters forward
input.shortcut: Outcome feature index 52 is clearedRows/16 and separates the unique target in every example; fitting cannot establish spatial reasoning or residual necessity

model.initialization: Cold same-seed make_model spatial; unchanged zero-initialized residual output; no old checkpoint load

fit.order: Fixed increasing row order; one optimizer update after all 16 per-example forward/backward operations
fit.loss: Mean native float32 cross_entropy over all 31 original candidates for each of 16 observations; flat loss only
fit.selection: Final step 200 only; no early stop, best-step reselection, extra seed, sweep, retry or continuation
fit.evaluation: 16 initial no-grad calls; 200*16 training calls; 2*16 final no-grad calls in eval mode on the same in-memory final model; original first-index raw argmax
fit.oldFitRunner: Do not call or modify fit_fixed; the future isolated runner implements fixed updates without dev selection

forwardBudget.scope: Count before each top-level SpatialCandidateCNN call; internal common/residual modules are not separate top-level calls; no extra telemetry or warmup forward

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch only; no install, GPU, service or external data transfer
resources.limits: Hard supervisor timeout; child sampled RSS at preparation, before/after each update and evaluation; instantaneous peak not measured; ledger and partial outputs retained on STOP

acceptance.technical: Exact source/config/data freeze, complete unique labels, legal order/schema, finite losses/gradients, exact ledger, immutable originals, repeat final logits and predictions byteexact
acceptance.margin: Every target logit minus highest non-target logit must be strictly greater than zero
acceptance.diagnostics: Initial and final top1/mean NLL/per-example target rank and margin; per-update mean training loss; no intermediate extra inference
acceptance.decision: Technical PASS and fitting PASS are separate. Technical failure STOP; compliant run missing any fit criterion is fit FAIL, not proof of insufficient capacity. Even fit PASS cannot change prior gates or app policy

boundaries.publicValidation: Node stdlib static contract, source/evidence byte hashes and deterministic subset/budget arithmetic only; no Python imports, model or domain execution
boundaries.interpretation: Proposed pipeline sanity/fit-only diagnostic, no comparator training arm, held-out generalization, spatial mechanism, prior failure repair, long survival, or product acceptance claim
boundaries.failure: STOP on mismatch, nonfinite, exhausted budget, process failure or overwrite; preserve partial evidence; no retry or automatic tuning
boundaries.future: Separate explicit decision required for synthetic fit data materialization, one 200-update CPU training run and at most 3248 top-level forward calls; prior budgets are spent
